title: EdgeCIM: A Hardware-Software Co-Design for CIM-Based Acceleration of Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.11512v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The growing demand for deploying Small Language Models (SLMs) on edge devices, including laptops, smartphones, automotive and robotic computing platforms, and high-performance embedded systems, has exposed fundamental inefficiencies in existing accelerators. While GPUs handle prefill workloads efficiently, the autoregressive decoding phase is dominated by GEMV operations that are inherently memory-bound, resulting in poor utilization and prohibitive energy costs at the edge. translated_title: EdgeCIM：一种基于存内计算（CIM）的小型语言模型加速软硬件协同设计
translated_abstract: 在边缘设备（包括笔记本电脑、智能手机、汽车与机器人计算平台以及高性能嵌入式系统）上部署小型语言模型（SLM）的需求不断增长，暴露了现有加速器的根本性低效问题。虽然GPU能够高效处理预填充（prefill）工作负载，但自回归解码阶段主要由本质上受内存限制的GEMV（矩阵-向量乘）操作主导，导致利用率低下以及边缘端难以承受的能耗成本。在这项工作中，我们提出了EdgeCIM，一个面向延迟敏感应用、用于在边缘设备上加速SLM自回归解码的软硬件协同设计框架。其核心是一个采用65纳米工艺实现的CIM宏单元，并搭配一种基于分块（tile）的映射策略，该策略能够平衡流水线各级，在最大化并行性的同时缓解DRAM带宽瓶颈。我们的模拟器支持对高达4B参数规模的SLM进行设计空间探索，识别硬…（原文截断）
tldr: EdgeCIM提出了一种软硬件协同设计框架，通过65nm CIM宏单元与基于分块的映射策略来平衡流水线各级并缓解DRAM带宽瓶颈，从而在边缘设备上高效加速小型语言模型的自回归解码。
en_tdlr: EdgeCIM presents a hardware-software co-design framework that combines a 65nm CIM macro with a tile-based mapping strategy to balance pipeline stages and alleviate DRAM bandwidth bottlenecks, enabling efficient acceleration of autoregressive decoding of small language models on edge devices.
